name: Hot Dog Bait Guide
description: Use Hot Dog with the Crab Fishing Rod for Rock Crab and Lobster. It does not belong to the Forest Island Piranha pool.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Hot Dog bait model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Hot Dog is available from the Lighthouse bait shop for $1 and remains available in later island shops.

sections.heading: When to use it
bullets: Equip the Crab Fishing Rod.
Use it for Rock Crab or Lobster in the opening route.
Switch to the normal Fishing Rod and Beginner Lure for Piranha.

name: Beginner Lure Guide
description: The first paid regular lure opens a nine-creature pool on Forest Island, including Goby, Salmon and a low-weight Sunfish result.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Beginner Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Buy Beginner Lure from Forest Island for $3. Later bait shops continue to stock it.

sections.heading: How to use it
bullets: Equip the Fishing Rod and Beginner Lure.
Use Beginner Boss Lure when you want an even Sunfish or The Old Pike pool.
A normal Beginner Lure can still roll Sunfish, but its pool weight is much lower.

name: Beginner Boss Lure Guide
description: Use the $40 Beginner Boss Lure for an even two-target pool containing Sunfish and The Old Pike.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Beginner Boss Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: The lure first appears in the Forest Island shop for $40 and is also sold on later islands.

sections.heading: Before casting
bullets: Use the Fishing Rod.
The lure is lost when a target takes it.
Giant Piranha uses quest-made Leech Bait instead.

name: Leech Bait
description: Collect three ground leeches during the Forest Island quest, trade them for Leech Bait and use it to call Giant Piranha.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Leech Bait model from How to Fish

sections.heading: How to get it
bullets: Accept the Forest Island bait quest.
Pick up three leeches from the ground.
Return them to receive Leech Bait.
Use the Fishing Rod and keep the resulting Giant Piranha trophy for the return hand-in.

sections.heading: Name shown in game
paragraphs: The inventory name is Leech Bait. Some older walkthroughs call it Modified Leech, so this page keeps the older address for saved links.

name: Standard Lure Guide
description: Standard Lure is the Desert Island regular pool, with ten possible creatures including Bowlfish and a low-weight Blue Shark result.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Standard Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Standard Lure first appears in the Desert Island shop for $15 and remains available on Islands 4 and 5.

sections.heading: Important pool differences
bullets: Salmon belongs to Beginner Lure, not Standard Lure.
Bowlfish is part of this pool.
Blue Shark has a small regular-lure weight; Standard Boss Lure gives it the dedicated pool.

name: Standard Boss Lure Guide
description: Standard Boss Lure gives Blue Shark its dedicated Desert Island pool and supports the Grillmaster hand-in.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Standard Boss Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Buy it from Desert Island for $280; the later shops also stock it.

sections.heading: Use in the Grillmaster route
bullets: Equip the Fishing Rod and Standard Boss Lure.
Defeat Blue Shark.
Keep the body and take it to the Grillmaster rather than selling it.

name: Carrot Bait
description: Complete the Desert Island bait quest to receive the Carrot, then use it with the Fishing Rod for Pufferfish.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Carrot bait model from How to Fish

sections.heading: How to get and use it
bullets: Catch Needlefish with Standard Lure.
Finish the tourist's bait trade.
Equip the Carrot on the Fishing Rod.
Keep the Pufferfish fin for the return hand-in that opens the next route.

name: Coconut Bait Guide
description: Coconut is a Desert Island shop bait with a dedicated Bing Bong pool. It is not stocked by the later island shops.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Coconut bait model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Buy Coconut from the Desert Island bait shop for $350. It is sold only on Island 3; the later shops do not stock it.

sections.heading: How to use it
bullets: Equip the Fishing Rod.
Select Coconut before casting.
The Coconut pool contains Bing Bong only.

name: Professional Lure Guide
description: Professional Lure has a twelve-creature Rocks Island pool, including Dripper and low-weight Tuna and Seahorse results.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Professional Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Professional Lure first appears in the Rocks Island shop for $50 and is also stocked on Volcano Island.

sections.heading: Important pool differences
bullets: Dripper belongs to this pool.
Tuna and Seahorse can appear at low pool weight.
Professional Boss Lure gives Tuna a dedicated catch pool.
Flounder is not in the Professional Lure catch table, so its method remains unconfirmed in the creature list.

name: Professional Boss Lure Guide
description: Professional Boss Lure gives Tuna its dedicated Rocks Island pool. Keep the body intact for the Albatross encounter.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Professional Boss Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Buy it on Rocks Island for $1,200. Volcano Island also stocks the lure.

sections.heading: Use in the Albatross route
bullets: Catch and defeat Tuna.
Do not sell or cook the body.
Place the defeated Tuna on land to trigger Albatross.

name: Scientific Lure Guide
description: Scientific Lure is the Volcano Island regular pool for Stonefish, Blobfish, Anglerfish, Oarfish and Superdwarf Fish.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Scientific Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: Scientific Lure is sold on Volcano Island for $500.

sections.heading: Farming notes
bullets: Stonefish, Blobfish and Anglerfish each carry equal top weight in this pool.
Oarfish has a lower weight.
Superdwarf Fish has the lowest raw weight of the five.

name: Scientific Boss Lure Guide
description: Scientific Boss Lure is the expensive Volcano Island lure with a dedicated Goblin Shark pool.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Scientific Boss Lure model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Where to buy it
paragraphs: The Volcano Island bait shop sells Scientific Boss Lure for $5,800.

sections.heading: Before buying it
bullets: Check whether Goblin Shark is still missing from your creature list.
Equip the Fishing Rod.
The lure is lost when the target takes it.

name: Fish Bucket
description: Complete the Volcano whale-bait quest to receive Fish Bucket, then use it with the Fishing Rod for Bowhead Whale.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Fish Bucket model from How to Fish

sections.heading: How to obtain it
bullets: Reach the Volcano Island scientist route.
Finish the whale-bait objective that requests five creatures.
Confirm Fish Bucket is in the bait slot before casting.

sections.heading: Use in the ending route
bullets: Use Fish Bucket to call Bowhead Whale.
Keep the defeated body intact.
Carry it into the Volcano trigger for the mutated final phase.

name: Empty Beer Can Bait
description: Complete the Lighthouse bait exchange, equip the returned Empty Beer Can on the Crab Fishing Rod and call Spider Crab.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Empty Beer Can bait model from How to Fish

sections.heading: How to get and use it
bullets: Complete the opening Beer Can exchange.
Equip Empty Beer Can on the Crab Fishing Rod.
Defeat Spider Crab and keep the quest result.
Return to the Lighthouse Keeper to continue the boat route.

name: Defeated Tuna Trigger
description: The defeated Tuna body is placed on land to draw in Albatross. It is a carried encounter object, not an equippable bait or lure.
imageAlt: In-game Tuna encounter image used for the Albatross trigger record

sections.heading: How the trigger works
bullets: Catch Tuna with Professional Boss Lure.
Do not sell or cook the body.
Place it on land to start the Albatross encounter.
Return the Albatross head after the fight.

name: Defeated Bowhead Whale Trigger
description: The defeated Bowhead Whale body starts the mutated final phase. It is a carried encounter object, not an equippable bait or lure.
imageAlt: In-game Bowhead Whale encounter image used for the final trigger record

sections.heading: How the trigger works
bullets: Defeat Bowhead Whale with Fish Bucket.
Keep the whale body intact.
Carry it into the Volcano final encounter area.
Defeat the mutated phase to complete the story route.
